A Reuters/Ipsos poll released Aug. 31 found that 33% of Americans approved of Trump’s job performance, marking the third consecutive week at that level.

The 33% rating was Trump’s lowest in Reuters/Ipsos polling since he returned to the White House in 2025. It also matched his lowest approval rating during his first term, which came in December 2017.

## What issues are affecting Trump's approval rating?

Recent polling has shown lower approval for Trump on several economic issues.

The September Marquette poll found 28% of adults approved of Trump’s handling of the economy, while 19% approved of his handling of inflation and the cost of living. His ratings were higher on border security, at 49%, and immigration, at 43%.

The latest Times/Siena survey also found the economy and cost of living among voters’ major concerns.
